_why: #91 and #11/H3 both shipped and neither was reachable through the cycle driver: `gate()` built its command with the collected report and `--ack-file` and nothing else, so every cycle driven through the script recorded `suite: null` with no leg set and its exit gate was refused `suite_unmeasured`. Three flags an orchestrator had to remember by hand — the 'instruction an orchestrator can skip' the gate itself names as the reason 91 cycles ran red. Each row restores one way the wiring can be present and inert.

mutations.name: the-suite-runs-once-per-LEG-instead-of-once-per-cycle
mutations._mechanism: The rejected design restored: minutes per leg, and `audit_suite_gate.json` already carries a row against running it on every gate invocation. Moving the run inside the loop also makes two legs of one cycle able to disagree about the suite.
mutations.find:
verdict, must, should, findings = gate(
                        collected_path,
                        ack_file=args.ack_file,
                        gated=args.gated,
                        legs=args.legs,
                        suite_result=suite_result,
                    )
mutations.replace:
if args.project_tests is not None:
                        from h_mad_audit_gate import run_suite as _rs
                        _rs(args.project_tests, args.suite_cmd.split() if args.suite_cmd else None)
                    verdict, must, should, findings = gate(
                        collected_path,
                        ack_file=args.ack_file,
                        gated=args.gated,
                        legs=args.legs,
                        suite_result=suite_result,
                    )

mutations.name: the-driver-stops-forwarding-the-leg-set
mutations._mechanism: Stamps carry no legs, so H3 can never refuse a changed leg set through the normal path — the gate is wired and inert, which reads as done.
mutations.find:
for leg in legs or []:
        command.extend(["--legs", leg])

mutations.name: the-driver-stops-forwarding-the-gated-documents
mutations._mechanism: No stamp is written at all, so nothing exists for `--exit-check` to read and the streak can never be established — the state every pre-#91 cycle was already in.
mutations.find:
for path in gated or []:
        command.extend(["--gated", str(path)])

mutations.name: the-suite-runs-on-every-cycle-whether-asked-or-not
mutations._mechanism: Every existing caller suddenly runs a test suite it never asked for — minutes per cycle and a behaviour change nobody opted into.
mutations.find:
if args.project_tests is not None:
        from h_mad_audit_gate import run_suite
mutations.replace:
if True:
        from h_mad_audit_gate import run_suite

mutations.name: GATE_RE-goes-back-to-refusing-a-gated-line
mutations._mechanism: The collision the gate's own comment recorded as latent: `--gated` appends ` gated=N` to line 1, and the anchored form then matches nothing, so every gated cycle dies with `ERROR: missing GATE token`. Latent only while the driver never passed the flag — which it now does.
